state.asymptotic_density_obstruction: Chebotarev density theorem provides auxiliary primes q = 2kp + 1 with 16q < p^2 and a_q(f) not in Adm_q(E)
state.deep_height_barrier: Open residuals (3, 4, 7) and (3, 5, 7) up to C <= 10,000 (C^7 <= 10^28, B <= 2,000,000) and power sums up to 10^30

chebotarev_density_witness.instructions: Does the Chebotarev density theorem on Frobenius conjugacy classes guarantee the existence of an auxiliary prime q = 2kp + 1 with 16q < p^2 such that a_q(f) does not match any Frey trace in Adm_q(E)?

criteria.true: Conjugacy classes avoiding the finite set of Frobenius traces Adm_q(E) have strictly positive Chebotarev density in Gal(K_f/Q)
criteria.false: Trace sets Adm_q(E) can cover the entire Galois group Gal(K_f/Q)

kraus_elimination_rate_30k.instructions: What is the expected elimination rate of the Kraus sieve across the 25,001 to 30,000 prime exponent range against newforms 72a1 and 144a1 with auxiliary multipliers k <= 50?

criteria.100_percent: 100% elimination rate achieved across all prime exponents
criteria.partial_elimination: Some prime exponents resist elimination within k <= 50

deep_height_barrier_10k.instructions: Does evaluating open residuals up to C <= 10,000 (B <= 2,000,000) and power sums up to 10^30 rigorously confirm the absence of small/medium-height counterexamples?

criteria.true: Empirical height barrier is extended beyond 10^28 with exact GCD tracking and zero coprime counterexamples
criteria.false: Search fails to constrain the height parameter space
